instruction_summary: Continuation of 001-living-update: reuse 001's completed headline (14 countries x 2009-2026) and all six gates, then finish the pre-declared secondary variants 001 had cut (V3 SES dispersion, V5 rent=20%AW, V6 one child, lhw=40 hours, employer-SSC inversion), and write the deliverables.

steps.description: Verify shared-data SHA256SUMS; link into workspace
Stage 001: copy code, checkpoints (251 headline + 14 gate4_j20), results, input_conventions.csv; repoint hardcoded 001 paths to 002
Gate 0: install .NET 8 runtime + euromod 0.4.0 + pandas/scipy/matplotlib; smoke-test AT_2025
steps.command: dotnet-install --runtime dotnet --channel 8.0; uv pip install euromod==0.4.0; python gate0

steps.description: Re-verify Gate 1 anchor (reproduce paper Table 2a through copied welfare_core.py)
outputs: SE Psi_d=8.35, PT Psi_w=0.99 match paper; max abs diff 0

steps.description: Run cut variants V5, V6, lhw40: 14 countries x {2009,2015,2020,2026}
Implement + run V3 (SES-dispersion stretch of r around median; all 14 countries) and log SES P90/P10
Fix inherited V5 rent no-op bug (xhcrt hard-coded 0 in _person; wire rent onto household head) and re-run V5
Run employer-SSC inversion sensitivity (2025 only, first-order using headline sicer ratios)
Re-run headline aggregation (reproduces 001 exactly) and aggregate all 5 variants at V4/q=0
Regenerate figures 1-3 and build fig4 (variant sensitivity + 2026 ranking robustness)

key_results.headline_regime: V4 (q=0); 7 of 14 countries no meaningful UB (inherited, reproduced bit-for-bit)
key_results.Psi_w_lt_Psi_d_2026: 8 of 10 stable countries (in-work transfer cheaper; flips to demogrant only in IE, SE)
key_results.central_finding: The paper's in-work-transfer-beats-demogrant ranking is ROBUST to all five pre-declared variants (Psi_w<Psi_d holds for 75-100% of stable countries throughout); bottom-decile participation traps (PTR->1) under 2009+ rules remain the key qualitative departure and destabilise the closed-form Psi for low deciles.
key_results.V5_bug_fixed: inherited code never applied rent (xhcrt hard-coded 0); fixed and re-run

comparison_to_original.quantity: Countries with Psi_w < Psi_d (in-work transfer cheaper)
comparison_to_original.followup: 8 of 10 stable (2026); 7-8 of <=10 across all 5 variants
comparison_to_original.note: paper's core finding survives and is robust to every pre-declared variant
set and q-regime differ; see report

comparison_to_original.quantity: Robustness of ranking to assumptions (dispersion, hours, children, rent, SSC basis)
comparison_to_original.followup: ranking never flips; V3 identical to headline (8/10)
comparison_to_original.note: the new contribution of this continuation

deviations: Headline regime is V4 (q=0) per pre-declared rule 3 (7 of 14 no meaningful UB); inherited from 001, reproduced bit-for-bit.
Psi levels unstable for low deciles (PTR/MTR->1 traps); Psi counts reported over 'stable' countries only; robust deliverables are decile profiles and bottom-quintile PTR change.
Fixed an inherited bug: V5 rent (xhcrt) was never applied in hh_engine (_person hard-coded xhcrt=0); fix wired rent onto the household head and V5 was re-run.
V3 dispersion operationalization is documented and labelled (log-r stretch around employment-weighted median decile position to match SES P90/P10); ran for all 14 countries (SES covers all).
Employer-SSC inversion is a documented first-order reparameterization using headline-2025 per-cell sicer ratios (2025 only); identity for gross-basis EL/IT.
Gate-0 output variable count 735 vs spec's ~446 is a connector artifact, not an error (7482 persons, 0 errors).
Inherited unchanged: EL/IT gross basis (sicer=0), IE 2021 missing (no hhot config), DE Midijob probe inconclusive, V_level_validated = {DK,FR}, V_delta = {DK,FI,FR,LU,NL,SE}.
